checks: Canonical full/delta digest round trip and signed zero
Malformed paths, digests, schemas, identities, and missing baselines do not advance acknowledgement
Cache discard preserves the highest admitted revision
Unknown acknowledgement and explicit discard produce full resync
Control fence changes force a full baseline
Relevance entry, exit, and same-life reentry preserve generation and death fences
Elapsed-tick frequency updates survive sparse polling
Large rotated supports remain in scoped collision; distant small shapes leave
Valid geometry exceeding baseline bytes is refused before retention
Shared extraction keeps private resources and HUD owner-bound
Host mutations invalidate the shared cache
Revocation and disconnect free retained bytes while preserving aggregate counters
One replaceable pipeline request coexists with ordered event and inventory reads
limitations: Population fixtures append distant actors to admitted DTO source lists; they do not simulate 128 additional NPCs or certify crowded battle capacity.
Per-viewer filtering still clones/scans bounded source lists; shared extraction and cell lists are reused between mutations.
Full diagnostic snapshots and initial movement-mode entry remain available outside normal delta polling.
Encoded byte counters measure generated packet bodies, not TLS frames or confirmed delivery.
The delayed TLS run has 12 sequential observations. Its p95 is the maximum sample; snapshot age is a configured lower bound from the downstream delay, not a synchronized WAN clock measurement.
TCP loss/retransmission, real WAN routes, rendering, GPU, and input-to-display latency were not tested.
Current actor/instance admission and replica generation-history limits remain.
Large conservative collision meshes can remain relevant to many viewers.

machine.build: cargo test; verse-world and physics opt-level=3, debug assertions and debug info enabled

scope: Deterministic DTO relevance/encoding and owned scratch TLS SDK fixtures; no GPU or external devices.

validation.ignored_reason: Process-crash child hooks are invoked by parent tests.

validation_history: Initial delayed movement deltas exposed signed-zero digest mismatch; canonical zero normalization and a regression test fixed it.
A fixture that directly mutates private game state now clears the shared cache explicitly; public host mutations invalidate it automatically.
